newsitem.title: UK: UK Trafficmaster in Mannesmann, Telekom deal.
newsitem.headline: UK Trafficmaster in Mannesmann, Telekom deal.

text.p: British traffic information group Trafficmaster Plc said on Wednesday it had signed a 12-year licensing deal with German engineering and telecommunications group Mannesmann AG and Deutsche Telekom AG.

Trafficmaster said Mannesmann Autocom and Deutsche Telekom's T-Mobil GmbH would set up a joint company to provide Trafficmaster services in Germany. The live traffic information network would be established by the end of this year.
Trafficmaster said it would receive royalties for each detection site installed, on the sale of YQ and Oracle in-car units and on a percentage of subscription revenue from both German companies.
Trafficmaster said it had also agreed with Mannesmann to market a pan-European service to car manufacturers using a common technical platform.

Trafficmaster said the service planned to cover around 4,000 kilometres of autobahn by the end of this year with a further 4,000 planned by mid-1998. It said the German motorway network covered over 10,000 kilometres.
